steps.title: Prepare buffers and reagents
steps.instruction: Add the volume of absolute ethanol indicated on each bottle label to the RPE Buffer and Wash Buffer, shake briefly and reseal the bottles. Prepare PBS (pH 7.2) for use with adherent cells. Use fresh or flash‑frozen samples stored at –70 °C; avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare sample according to source
steps.instruction: Process the sample type as described below before proceeding to DNA/RNA separation.

substeps.instruction: Adherent cultured animal cells: remove medium, wash with PBS, aspirate PBS, add 0.10‑0.25 % Trypsin in PBS, detach cells, add medium and transfer to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.

Suspension cultured animal cells: transfer up to 5 × 10⁶ cells to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, centrifuge 5 min at 300 × g, discard supernatant, add 400 µL DR Buffer + 4 µL β‑mercaptoethanol and resuspend by pipetting or vortexing.

Animal tissue (10‑25 mg, max 25 mg per reaction): either (A) place tissue with ceramic or steel beads in a 2 mL tube, add 400 µL DR Buffer + 4 µL β‑mercaptoethanol and homogenize with a TissueLyser/Disruptor Genie, or (B) freeze in liquid nitrogen, grind with mortar and pestle, keep frozen, transfer powder to a 1.5 mL tube, add 400 µL DR Buffer + 4 µL β‑mercaptoethanol and shear through a 20‑G needle syringe 10 times.
Biological fluids: add 300 µL DR Buffer + 3 µL β‑mercaptoethanol to 100 µL liquid sample, mix well.

Human whole blood: collect fresh blood in anticoagulant tubes, transfer 500 µL to a sterile 15 mL tube, add 1.5 mL RBC Lysis Buffer (3 vol), invert to mix, incubate on ice 10 min (vortex briefly twice), centrifuge 5 min at 3,000 × g, discard supernatant, add 400 µL DR Buffer + 4 µL β‑mercaptoethanol and resuspend the leukocyte pellet.

steps.title: Separate DNA and RNA on GD column
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge 12‑16,000 × g for 2 min, load supernatant onto a GD Column in a 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge 14‑16,000 × g for 1 min (extend time if flow is incomplete). Save the flow‑through for RNA purification, place the GD Column in a new 2 mL tube and store at 15‑25 °C or 4 °C (do not freeze) for later DNA purification. Pre‑heat 200 µL Elution Buffer per sample to 60 °C for the upcoming DNA elution.

steps.title: Bind RNA to RB column
steps.instruction: Add 0.8 × volume absolute ethanol to the saved flow‑through (e.g., 320 µL ethanol to 400 µL flow‑through), mix, transfer to an RB Column in a 2 mL tube, centrifuge 14‑16,000 × g for 1 min, and place the RB Column in a new 2 mL tube; keep the flow‑through for protein purification.

substeps.instruction: Optional in‑column DNase I digestion: add 400 µL RPE Buffer (with ethanol already added) to the RB Column, centrifuge 14‑16,000 × g for 30 s, discard flow‑through, and return the column to a 2 mL tube. Prepare DNase I mix by combining 5 µL DNase I (2 U/µL) with 45 µL DNase I Reaction Buffer in a RNase‑free 1.5 mL tube (total 50 µL, do not vortex). Add the 50 µL DNase I solution to the centre of the RB column matrix, incubate 15 min at room temperature (20‑30 °C), then continue with RNA wash.

steps.title: Wash RNA on RB column
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL RW1 Buffer, centrifuge 14‑16,000 × g for 30 s, discard flow‑through.
Add 600 µL RPE Buffer (ethanol already added), centrifuge 14‑16,000 × g for 30 s, discard flow‑through.
Repeat the 600 µL RPE Buffer addition and centrifugation.
Centrifuge the RB Column at 14‑16,000 × g for 3 min to dry the matrix.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Place the RB Column in a clean RNase‑free 1.5 mL tube, add 25‑50 µL RNase‑free water to the centre of the matrix, let stand ≥1 min for absorption, then centrifuge 14‑16,000 × g for 1 min to collect purified RNA.

steps.title: Precipitate protein from flow‑through
steps.instruction: Add 4 volumes ice‑cold acetone to the flow‑through collected in step 3 (e.g., 2.8 mL acetone to 700 µL flow‑through) in a 15 mL tube, incubate on ice or at –20 °C for 30 min, centrifuge 14‑16,000 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant, and proceed to DNA purification as described in the kit manual (page 7).

steps.title: Resuspend protein pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellet with up to 100 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, discard the ethanol, air‑dry the pellet at room temperature (do not overdry), then add up to 100 µL DV buffer (8 M urea) or another compatible buffer to dissolve the protein.

steps.title: Prepare protein for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: In a clean tube combine 2 µL Protein Loading Dye and, optionally, 0.5 µL 2 M DTT, add 8 µL of the dissolved protein sample, mix, incubate at 100 °C for 3‑5 min, briefly centrifuge, and load the supernatant onto an SDS‑PAGE gel.

steps.title: Purify DNA
steps.instruction: Elute DNA from the GD Column using 200 µL pre‑heated Elution Buffer (60 °C) as described in the kit instructions (see page 7).

Introduction
The DNA/RNA/Protein Extraction Kit provides an efficient method for purifying genomic DNA, total RNA and total protein simultaneously from a variety of samples (cultured cells, animal tissue, whole blood and biological liquids). Chaotropic salt is used to lyse cells and inactive DNases and RNases, allowing DNA to bind to the genomic DNA spin column. The flow-through can then be transferred to the RNA spin column for RNA binding. The proteins in the flow-through can then be precipitated using acetone. Contaminants are effectively removed using wash buffers followed by pure genomic DNA elution in a low salt buffer and pure total RNA elution in RNase-free Water. DNA/RNA purification can be completed in 25 minutes without phenol/chloroform extraction or alcohol precipitation and protein purification can be completed in 50 minutes. The purified DNA, with approximately 20-30 Kb, is suitable for use in PCR or other enzymatic reactions and the purified RNA (including miRNA) is ready for use in RT-PCR, Real-time PCR, northern blotting, primer extension, mRNA selection and cDNA synthesis. The purified proteins can be directly analyzed on a SDS-PAGE and subsequent western blot.
Quality Control
The quality of the DNA/RNA/Protein Extraction Kit is tested on a lot-to-lot basis by isolating genomic DNA, total RNA and protein from cultured animal cells. The purified DNA and total RNA is quantified with a spectrophotometer and analyzed by electrophoresis on a 1% agarose gel. The purified protein is quantified by bradford assay and analyzed on SDS-PAGE.
